items.title: Intuitive Surgical (ISRG) Dropped, So What Is Driving Attention Now?
items.summary: Intuitive Surgical (ISRG) is back in focus after fresh quarterly results showed 22% revenue growth, rising use of its da Vinci 5 and Ion systems, and a sizable US$450 million antitrust settlement charge. The share price reaction has been choppy. Intuitive Surgical’s stock is up 12.15% over the past 90 days and 6.15% over the past 30 days, yet down 19.92% on a year-to-date basis. The 3-year total shareholder return of 54.32% still points to a stronger longer-run record than the 1-year total...

items.title: Intuitive Surgical (ISRG) Stock Fair Value Edges Higher After Mixed Q3 Analyst Revisions
items.summary: Intuitive Surgical is back on many investors’ radar after a fresh tweak to its fair value estimate, which has shifted from about US$476.34 to roughly US$486.57 per share. That change sits against a mixed analyst narrative, with recent Q3 commentary balancing upbeat system placements and procedure growth against concerns about U.S. volume deceleration and higher expectations already reflected in the stock.
